reviews.title: Better Sources Out There
reviews.text: I’m severely disappointed as this was my go to Bible app for awhile. With the most recent update it brought along ads as well. While I appreciate the great amount of resources they offer; I fear this app—like most things today—has turned into a cash grab. The free resources that are offered every month is great, but if I’m going to spend money anywhere it would be Logos. However, the real reason I’m quite upset with this app is the inclusion of ads. While it’s not the first to do it it’s disappointing that the developers would stop so low to take advantage of good kind people.

reviews.title: Needs Major Improvements
reviews.text:
Not sure why your Tecarta fails to hire skilled software Architects, developers and analysts. The existing functionality in the year 2026 is still not even in the league with the other new Bible software technologies. 

This software is “old news “. There is a long list of improvements needed. 

By the way, I build very successful software products for major corporations all over the world for approximately 24 years. Much larger deployment applications. So I am not like the average user who may not be aware of defects and industry standards for applications. 

Anyway, adding new books/relevant material, content is also overdue. 

Further, while viewing Biblical passages, certain resources cannot be copied to the notes. Inconsistent functionalities for the user experience.

The user should be able to make more edits/selections to tailor his/her home page. 

Navigation to certain areas is challenging and in some cases is poor design. 

Unable to upload attachments from external sources to Bible passage. 

Additional color highlighting selections should be added. Today people actively study the Holy Bible. 

Simple enhancements are not costly. 

The recent release still does not measure up.

reviews.title: Why do we have ads on a bible app?
reviews.text: I will never use this app. With the initial update I always just swiped up when the ads prompt came and the refreshed the app. This time the ad came, it for whatever reason I didn’t refresh the app, and unfortunately Life Bible brought up the most DISGUSTING INNAPROPRIATE SINFUL WICKED AD I HAVE EVER SEEN!!!! Even though I enjoy the dramatized Bible I will no longer use this app.

reviews.title: I once loved this app - NOW A VERY DISAPPOINTED USER
reviews.text: My heart is so disappointed. I have spent years using this app as a way to record my walk with Jesus. Hours and hours of highlighting, taking notes, and using this as a source for studying. Now, for some reason, they have decided to pause on carrying a specific translation. This is so grievous to my heart. To think that the Church can spend so much time trying to decide what everyone else’s walk with the Holy Spirit should look like. Now, just as the translation will be completely done, I will not have access to the new books as they are released. I pay the annual subscription but will not actually get what I paid for. The stance this company has decided to make I feel grieves the Holy Spirit more than anything. So, I would be EXTREMELY cautious doing as I have done where you’ve stored everything on this one app and they can choose to stop carrying something just because they want to. I am now looking for another route to take for sure.

reviews.title: No Bookmarks
reviews.text: There is no way to create or access bookmarks. They have a help section that supposedly gives instructions on how to do that, but following the instructions doesn’t do anything.

reviews.title: Create a desktop app people!
reviews.text: Studying the Bible on desktop using the iPad app is painful. You need a proper desktop ap. I’m now deleting this app and using Logos.

reviews.title: Too fussy
reviews.text: I love the clarity and simplicity of the old app. This has gone all fussy and American. When I open my Bible I want to see my Bible, not a distracting bunch of options and frills.

reviews.title: Advert?
reviews.text: Clicked the verse of the day and got a pop up saying my phone has been hacked. Obviously fake but why is that coming up in this app? Deleted.
